en.title: Reciprocal pronouns
en.summary: Each other and one another show an action done both ways.

paragraphs: A reciprocal pronoun shows that two or more people (or things) do the same action to each other. English has two: each other and one another.

items: We write to **each other** every week.

paragraphs: Each other and one another are interchangeable in most contexts. Some writers use each other for two people and one another for more than two, but this rule is not strict. The pronouns act as objects and have a possessive form with an apostrophe: each other's, one another's.

blocks.html:
FormExample
each otherThey know each other well.
one anotherThe members support one another.
each other'sThey borrowed each other's books.
preposition + each otherThey talk to each other.

paragraphs: A reflexive pronoun refers to the same person; a reciprocal pronoun refers to two people acting on each other. The meaning is different.

blocks.html:
ReflexiveReciprocal
They blamed themselves. (each blamed himself or herself)They blamed each other. (A blamed B, and B blamed A)
We looked at ourselves.We looked at each other.

items: Wrong: **They saw themselves at the station.** (if you mean A saw B and B saw A) Right: **They saw each other.**
Wrong: **They helped each others.** Right: **each other.**
Wrong: **They like to each other.** Right: **They like each other.**

ro.title: Pronumele reciproce
ro.summary: Pronumele reciproce arată o acțiune reciprocă între două sau mai multe persoane.

paragraphs: O acțiune reciprocă arată că două sau mai multe persoane fac același lucru reciproc. Limba română nu are pronume reciproce separate. Folosim pronumele reflexive la plural împreună cu expresii precum „unul pe altul”.
Așezăm pronumele reflexiv (ne, vă, se, își) înaintea verbului. Adăugăm expresia „unul pe altul” după verb pentru claritate. Această expresie își schimbă forma după gen și după caz.

blocks.html:

Acuzativ masculinse ajutăunul pe altul
Acuzativ femininse ajutăuna pe alta
Acuzativ pluralse ajutăunii pe alții
Dativ masculinîși vorbescunul altuia
